subject: Sandbox activity chain-of-custody + log slice schema
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@healthsync.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0500
Subject: Sandbox activity chain-of-custody + log slice schema

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for your time on the demo earlier — really appreciated the candid walkthrough of the sandbox workflows. Per our call, I wanted to capture the next steps and clarify the audit/evidence items your compliance team requested so we can scope an exact deliverable.

High-level ask from HealthSync compliance (as I understood it):
- Provide a who/what/when chain-of-custody for sandbox/test activity for a 90-day window.
- Include prompt/response metadata, user/session ids (pseudonymized if needed), and the agent/service that accessed the model.
- Export format preference: CSV for timelines, plus JSON for full event records and nested metadata.
- A redaction policy or example slice where PII fields are redacted and rationale documented.
- Confirmation of where logs are stored (region) and retention policy applied for sandbox vs production.

Questions for you before we produce a draft:
1) Does HealthSync want a single canonical CSV timeline keyed on event_id, or do you prefer separate CSVs per resource type (sessions, prompts, file uploads)?
2) For PII redaction — do you want redaction at export time only, or should we include both raw (hashed) and redacted columns?
3) Is there a minimum set of session identifiers we should map to your internal user ids (we can accept a hash salt provided by you)?

Planned deliverables from Redwood:
- Sample 48-hour slice export (CSV + JSON) demonstrating format and redaction.
- One-page chain-of-custody playbook describing collection points and custody transitions.
- Short runbook for how to re-run the export and verification steps for auditors.

If you can confirm preferred CSV layout and redaction stance, we’ll turn around the sample slice by Thursday EOD.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-audit-slice-spec.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: chain_of_custody_playbook.pdf (PDF)]

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@healthsync.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@healthsync.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Sandbox activity chain-of-custody + log slice schema

Thanks, Evelyn — that summary is exactly right. A couple of clarifications from Legal: 

- Single canonical CSV is preferable (easier to ingest into our evidence portal). One row per event with an event_type column is fine.
- Legal would like both raw identifiers (hashed with a customer-provided salt) and a redacted display_id column for anything that could be PII. So please include both.
- For the runbook, include the exact API calls (curl examples) and an export hash/checksum so we can validate integrity.
- Region: all logs for HealthSync must be stored and exported from us-east-1.

Two asks on deadlines: can you get the sample 48-hour slice by Thursday (11/12) EOD? Also, we’ll need a short attestation for auditors that the slice is complete and unmodified from the time window.

CC’ing Legal Ops so they can ping if there are extra contractual items.

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager, HealthSync

Samir — thanks for the quick clarifications. We’ll proceed with the canonical CSV (one row per event) and include:
- event_id, timestamp (ISO8601 with TZ), event_type, resource_type, hashed_user_id (SHA256 with your salt), display_id_redacted, prompt_text_truncated, response_length_tokens, model_variant, region, source_ip (redacted partial), operator (internal service/agent), and integrity_checksum.

We’ll also include a companion NDJSON file with the raw event payloads for auditors who want nested metadata. For the attestation, Redwood Legal will prepare a short statement confirming the export was produced from our logs and include an export hash signed by our key.

Deliverables and ETA:
- 48-hour sample slice (CSV + NDJSON) with redaction columns: ETA Thursday 2026-11-12 17:00 US/Eastern.
- Chain-of-custody playbook draft: ETA Friday 2026-11-13 12:00 US/Eastern.
- Export runbook + curl examples + checksum generation: included with the slice.

Aditya / Marissa — can your teams generate the export and attach the CSV/NDJSON sample to a Drive folder and share the link with HealthSync legal? Also confirm the export will be produced from us-east-1 staging logs.

Thanks,
Evelyn
